The names in the M40 line up were awesome, with Jon Wigley, Mike Hager, Dave Hill and Peter Banks having been ahead of all of the Belgrave seniors in the National Champs at Newark.
Veterans: D.Hill (Thames H&H) 5 pts. Young Athletes: R.Xerri (Hercules Wimbledon) 8 pts.

At the front the race was dominated by Thames Hare and Hounds with Dave Hill winning as he pleased and Mike Farmery, another new Vet, coming through strongly for second ahead of Chris Hughes and a tired Charlie Dickinson.
Dave Hill won the men's race for the third consecutive year. He got away early with the rest of the pack, apart from Steve Badgery, reluctant to follow.

Jim Estall was soon in at 18th, just one place down on fellow veteran Dave Hill, but then it was a long, long wait for our fourth man.
